Dear Hiring Team,

I'm applying for the Technical & E-commerce Support Analyst role at Viva Wallet in Brussels. With a technical background in web development and e-commerce, plus hands-on experience supporting merchants on platforms like Shopify and WooCommerce, I'm drawn to Viva Wallet's mission to simplify payments for businesses.

In my current roles, I build and maintain WordPress and Shopify stores, troubleshoot integrations, and use AI tools daily to diagnose and resolve issues efficiently. I've worked with APIs, JSON-LD, and payment-related configurations, and I'm comfortable explaining technical solutions to non-technical users. I speak fluent English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1 writing level, and I'm eager to strengthen my Dutch in a professional setting.

I'd welcome the chance to discuss how my problem-solving skills and customer-focused approach can support your merchants.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm writing to apply for the Technical & E-commerce Support Analyst position at Viva Wallet in Brussels. Your focus on omnichannel payments and all-in-one business solutions resonates with my experience at the intersection of web development, e-commerce, and technical problem-solving.

In my current freelance and junior digital marketing roles, I build and maintain websites on WordPress and Shopify, manage product catalogues, and troubleshoot technical issues for clients. I've worked with e-commerce integrations, including plugins and payment configurations, and I regularly use APIs and JSON-LD to connect systems and improve functionality. My background in front-end development (AngularJS, JavaScript) gives me a solid foundation for diagnosing software and connectivity issues, and I'm comfortable using AI tools to speed up research and resolution.

I understand that this role requires a customer-oriented mindset and the ability to explain technical solutions clearly. I've supported clients through email and ticketing systems, documented procedures, and collaborated with team members to resolve complex requests. I'm fluent in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1 writing level, and I'm motivated to develop my Dutch further in a professional environment.

I'm eager to bring my technical skills and ownership mindset to Viva Wallet's Customer Operations team, helping merchants resolve payment issues and ensuring smooth payment operations. I'd welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cv_highlights:
• Built and maintained e-commerce stores on Shopify and WooCommerce, including product catalogue management and plugin configurations.
• Provided technical support and troubleshooting for client websites, diagnosing software, connectivity, and integration issues.
• Working knowledge of APIs, JSON-LD, and payment gateway integrations, with hands-on experience in front-end development (AngularJS, JavaScript).
• Daily use of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) and prompt engineering to automate research and resolve technical problems efficiently.
• Strong communication skills in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1 writing level, and a customer-focused approach to support.
